title: Neural Realized Measures: Forecast-Supervised Intraday Aggregation for Volatility Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.07287v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-frequency volatility forecasting typically separates measurement from prediction: intraday observations are first compressed into a daily realized measure using a fixed aggregation rule, and the resulting statistic is then passed to a forecasting model. This conventional pipeline therefore treats measure construction as forecast-agnostic preprocessing. We ask whether the aggregation stage itself can instead be learned from the downstream forecasting objective while preserving the statistical structure of established realized measures. We propose Neural Realized Measures (NRM), a primitive-preserving, forecast-supervised aggregation framework that retains the original measure-specific intraday contributions but replaces uniform aggregation with positive, mean-normalized context-dependent weights. Uniform weights exactly recover the corresponding raw realized measure (RRM), so the classical construction is nested as a special case. Be

translated_title: 神经实现测度：面向波动率预测的预测监督型日内聚合方法
translated_abstract: 高频波动率预测通常将测量与预测两个环节分离：日内观测首先通过固定的聚合规则被压缩为日度实现测度，随后所得统计量再被传入预测模型。因此，这种传统流程将测度构建视为与预测无关的预处理步骤。我们提出这样的问题：聚合阶段本身能否基于下游预测目标进行学习，同时保留既有实现测度的统计结构。我们提出神经实现测度（NRM），这是一个保持原语、以预测为监督的聚合框架，它保留了原始的测度特定日内贡献，但以正的、均值归一化且依赖上下文的权重取代了均匀聚合。当使用均匀权重时，可以精确恢复相应的原始实现测度（RRM），因此经典构造被嵌套为该框架的特例。
tldr: 该论文提出神经实现测度（NRM），一种以波动率预测为监督、通过可学习的正的上下文相关权重来聚合日内观测的框架，将经典实现测度嵌套为特例，从而改进波动率预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Neural Realized Measures (NRM), a forecast-supervised aggregation framework that learns positive, mean-normalized, context-dependent weights for intraday aggregation, nesting classical realized measures as a special case to improve volatility forecasting.
